name: Joel
bio: Trip organizer. Plays off a self-reported handicap that nobody has ever verified.
quirk: Will not stop talking about his new driver.

name: Niklas
bio: Lives out in the countryside with two cats, both of whom have watched more of his practice swings than any human ever will.
quirk: Insists the fresh country air is worth twenty extra yards.

name: Jacob
bio: Girl-dad who gets paid to play video games at work, and maintains that this is legitimate training for reading greens.
quirk: Counts respawning as a free drop.
